name: [QUESTS 🌌] The Hybrid Cafe ☕
desc:
Seems like your new cafe job didn't turn out how you expected...

☕ Mix and serve countless combinations of delicious drinks and snacks to hungry customers! Earn tips to buy upgrades and decorate your cafe! Enjoy the sound of waves and the cool breeze as you work on a tropical island.

⚠️ However, running a cafe isn't that easy! Despite aggressive people, broken machines and earthquakes, you're expected to stop at nothing to serve our loyal customers... You have been warned...

Type /return in the chat in-game to quickly return to the lobby.

Built by @real_haemster. Programmed by @Bili_Billie.
